sampling.rule: equally spaced indices in each episode's ordered valid_action_starts
sampling.noise: fixed float32 Gaussian [10,32], keyed by seed/episode/frame; same across checkpoints and model families

motion_groups.moving: any of next 10 targets differs from current state by >= 0.5 joint degrees or >= 1.0 gripper mm
motion_groups.low_motion: all differences below both descriptive thresholds

aggregation: equal weight per episode within each group; RMSE fields are means of per-episode RMSE
normalized_mse7: all seven real action dimensions, using this model's train normalization scale; compare checkpoints within the same model
